message: The other night, we had a little power outage, and my friend Sarah called, totally in a tizzy. I could hear her rummaging through her drawers, looking for flashlights and candles—yikes! I was just cozying up with my lantern and a good book, feeling pretty prepared. It made me realize how important it is to have a plan and the right gear ready. Have you ever had a moment like that when you felt ready while someone else was in a panic?
